title: Shadows Behind the Marble Desk
description: You are Mr. Hayes, a professional but debt-ridden Attorney General. Your integrity is tested by your family's financial needs and lifestyle.

chapter1.title: Chapter 1: Salary and Promise Dilemma
chapter1.description: Your monthly salary is wiped out by installments and children's school fees. Debts pile up, and your desk is quiet from lucrative cases. You need quick cash.
chapter1.dilemma: What should be done to pay off debts?

A.description: Open Elite Cases & Demand Hush Money
A.feedback: Your wallet is instantly thick, but now the elite hold an ace card against you.

B.feedback: The result is modest, but you sleep soundly without fear.

chapter2_A.title: Chapter 2: Towards the Legislature (Dark Path)
chapter2_A.description: Bribe money in hand, but the fear of scandal haunts you. You want to move to the Legislative branch for immunity and a bigger salary.
chapter2_A.dilemma: How to get a legislative seat?

A.description: Resign & Build a False Integrity Image
A.feedback: You use illicit money to polish a clean image. Ironic.

B.feedback: You sell your soul to a political sponsor. The risk of being caught skyrockets.

chapter2_B.title: Chapter 2: Towards the Legislature (Merit Path)
chapter2_B.description: Your reputation is good, but life's needs are pressing. A Legislative seat offers a large salary and a chance to serve (or corrupt).
chapter2_B.dilemma: How to get a legislative seat?

A.description: Honest Campaign Based on Legal Issues
A.feedback: Savings are drained for the campaign, but public support is genuine.

B.feedback: You are tempted by the shortcut. Political sponsors now control you.

chapter3_A.title: Chapter 3: Opposition in the Council
chapter3_A.description: You are elected. However, the council meeting is tough. There's a chance for a big project if you can silence the opposition.
chapter3_A.dilemma: How to deal with opposing council members?

A.feedback: Politics is the art of compromise. Everyone is happy (and satisfied).

B.feedback: They are quiet out of fear, not agreement. Enemies in disguise multiply.

chapter3_B.title: Chapter 3: Sponsor Pressure
chapter3_B.description: The political sponsors demand fulfillment of promises. You must pass a major project amidst intense council debate.
chapter3_B.dilemma: How to deal with opposing council members?

A.feedback: You learn to play smartly. The project passes, everyone gets a share.

B.feedback: Thug tactics are effective, but your criminal trail becomes clearer.

chapter4_A.title: Chapter 4: Friend Entangled in Case
chapter4_A.description: Your career is smooth, but your close friend is caught extorting the public. If he sings, you could be implicated.
chapter4_A.dilemma: Save your friend or protect your reputation?

A.feedback: You sacrifice your friend for the law. Heartache, but reputation is safe.

B.description: Bribe Law Enforcement & Cover Up Case
B.feedback: Your friend is safe, but now Law Enforcement holds an ace card against you.

chapter4_B.title: Chapter 4: Friend Entangled in Case (Dark Network)
chapter4_B.description: Your friend in the dark network is caught. If he talks, all your manipulations will be exposed.
chapter4_B.dilemma: Save your friend or protect your reputation?

A.description: Wash Hands & Push for Legal Process
A.feedback: You betray your own accomplice. You are safe, for now.

B.feedback: The case disappears, but you are increasingly blackmailed by your own crimes.

chapter5_A.title: Chapter 5: The Bridge Project (Clean Reputation)
chapter5_A.description: Your funds are depleted due to your friend's legal process. There's a giant National Bridge project. A 2% corruption opportunity is very tempting.
chapter5_A.dilemma: Take profit or maintain bridge quality?

A.feedback: The people get a solid bridge. You are proud, even if your wallet is thin.

B.feedback: Money goes into your account. The bridge is now a fragile time bomb.

chapter5_B.title: Chapter 5: The Bridge Project (Dirty Reputation)
chapter5_B.description: Your reputation is ruined. The National Bridge project is a chance to restore your name (or increase your coffers before being fired).
chapter5_B.dilemma: Take profit or maintain bridge quality?

A.feedback: A step of repentance. The public starts to believe in you again.

B.feedback: You no longer care. Corruption continues while in office.

chapter6_A.title: Chapter 6: Targeting Security General
chapter6_A.description: Your image as a clean politician makes you confident in targeting the Security General seat. But you need 'muscle'.

A.feedback: A democratic approach. Slow, but legitimate.

B.feedback: You have a private army now. Democracy weeps.

chapter6_B.title: Chapter 6: Targeting Security General (For Protection)
chapter6_B.description: The trail of bridge corruption haunts you. You need the Security General position to be immune from the law and cover your tracks.

A.feedback: You hide behind a reformist mask.

B.feedback: Absolute power is your only protector now.

chapter7_A.title: Chapter 7: Dissolution Threat
chapter7_A.description: The PM wants to dissolve your Security General position. Your reforms are considered a threat.

A.feedback: The position is safe, but Parliament now belongs to the highest bidder.

B.feedback: Achievements silence opponents. Your position is unshakable.

chapter7_B.title: Chapter 7: Dissolution Threat (Coup Issue)
chapter7_B.description: Your mercenaries make the PM fear a coup. He wants to fire you immediately.

A.feedback: You use fear to rule. A small dictator is born.

B.feedback: You successfully convince the PM that your forces are useful.

chapter8_A.title: Chapter 8: Defense Budget (Reciprocity)
chapter8_A.description: The position is safe due to bribes. Now the friends who helped you demand a reward. There is a large arms procurement budget.
chapter8_A.dilemma: Mark up the budget or disappoint friends?

A.feedback: Loyalty is bought with public money. The circle of corruption strengthens.

B.feedback: Friends are angry and leave you, but the country saves trillions.

chapter8_B.title: Chapter 8: Defense Budget (Professional)
chapter8_B.description: Your performance is good. A large budget is approved. Your expert team expects a large bonus from this project.
chapter8_B.dilemma: Mark up the budget or disappoint the team?

A.feedback: You taint your own achievement for money.

B.feedback: Integrity is perfectly maintained. You are a rare official.

chapter9_A.title: Chapter 9: Towards PM (Dirty Capital)
chapter9_A.description: With corruption money, you run for Prime Minister. Political opponents are strong, but your funds are unlimited.
chapter9_A.dilemma: What is the election winning strategy?

A.feedback: Trying to win cleanly despite the dirty capital.

B.feedback: You resort to all means necessary. Democracy dies in your hands.

chapter9_B.title: Chapter 9: Towards PM (Integrity Capital)
chapter9_B.description: Your reputation is clean, but campaign funds are limited. You run for PM against a political giant.
chapter9_B.dilemma: What is the election winning strategy?

A.feedback: An honorable victory is within sight.

B.feedback: In the last minute, you are tempted by power and betray your principles.

chapter10_A.title: Chapter 10: Leadership Crisis
chapter10_A.description: You become PM, but are shaken by demonstration issues. The coalition is starting to crack.

A.feedback: A true statesman is born in crisis. Your name is celebrated forever.

B.feedback: You survive, but as a political puppet.

chapter10_B.title: Chapter 10: Leadership Crisis (Corrupt Regime)
chapter10_B.description: You became PM through fraud. The people are angry and demand you step down.

A.feedback: A late attempt to fix the damage. History records your dualism.

B.feedback: You become the tyrant you once hated. Absolute power, zero morality.
